Education · programme

Leadership Ramallah

A two-day summit for young Palestinian-American adults, held alongside the Mid-Year Meeting, with expert-led workshops on leadership, advocacy and cultural preservation.

Branch
Education · A ladder by age
Owning entity
AFRP
Shape
Cohort · flagship
Built in the Hub
Plan only

Who it's for

Active AFRP members aged 21 and over. Standing is By-Law 4.3.1 in full: national and club dues both current.

The operating year

Applications open each fall; the summit runs at the Mid-Year Meeting (February to March).

The five rungs

RungFor this programme
HearAn invitation to former camp counselors reaching 21, naming what they already did. One-summer campers are not listed.
Show upThe two-day summit; standing is checked at the door and a refusal names which dues lapsed.
Take partThe cohort. It is too small to report on, so anything published is suppressed.
Give or serveAn alum who comes back to facilitate a session.
LeadA seat won nearby: the summit sits beside the Mid-Year Meeting, where Member-at-Large candidacies are filed.

Who runs it

The Leadership Ramallah Committee, a standing committee that runs the summit at the Mid-Year Meeting. What it escalates is not stated.

Money

AFRP, supported by the Endowed Fund: ARFECF 6.3.1 names it, so it can receive an endowment distribution. Cohort costs are not stated.

Hand-offs

Fed by Camp counselors, Project Hope and scholarship recipients. Feeds the Day of Action, RBPN, and Board and committee seats.
